$comment: Reviewed choices for scripts/make-zone-map.mjs (Day 4 design section 5.1). Read with zone.tab: a country whose zones
all keep the same UTC offsets is called on its first zone.tab zone (or on 'main' below). A country whose zones differ
needs a 'span' (called only while both ends are in office hours, until someone picks the lead's zone) or a 'main' zone
(called on that zone's hours); the script stops when one has neither. 'choices' is the closed list of zones a person
may pick for a lead in a country with several (by default one zone per distinct offset, the main zone first). A list
here also keeps to long-standing zone names that every PostgreSQL and browser has (CL: Punta_Arenas, not the 2025
Coyhaique). Span ends are written east first; the script checks the order. 'noZone': places with no one to call (Antarctica, the US
minor islands): no calling zone, so such a lead is called on the default zone (Europe/Paris), like a lead with no
